sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
PhD route includes 90 credits beyond bachelor’s (60 beyond master’s); UChicago bachelor’s an eligible degree
basis. International applicants accepted; substantive math preparedness reviewed by committee. [s3] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare PDF personal statement, CV, complete transcripts and three referee names/emails; fee payment
completes submission. Financial-resource documents may follow review but required for I-20 after admission.
[s1] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Melissa Emory explicitly welcomes prospective PhD email with brief
background/interests:melissa.emory@okstate.edu. No department-wide supervisor-preapproval requirement
found. [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Slate; application status available after submission. Central FAQ says submitted application cannot be edited;
check with admissions for corrections. [s1] [s5] [s7]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing admissions/funding; English policies updated for 2026 scale.2027 financial package not published in
checked sources. [s1] [s6]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Funding consideration [Standing rule]
February 1 fall full-consideration deadline; applications accepted rolling afterward. Standing dates, no explicit
2027-specific funding schedule. [s1] [s3]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Full materials by February 1 for full consideration; central says program may decline late/incomplete files.
Self-reported English results accepted initially, official needed for final admission. [s5] [s6] [s7]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL 79(old)/4.0(new from January 21, 2026), IELTS 6.5, DET 115, PTE 53; 2 year validity. Program may set
higher minimum/limit acceptedtests. [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Central application process exempts completed OR completing English-medium bachelor’s/graduate degree in
English-primary country, supporting UChicago in-progress degree. International page instead says request

earned-degree waiver; confirm checklist clearance. Completed qualifying degree is also exempt from ITA
policy. [s5] [s6] [s8]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE not required and omission not counted against applicant; scores welcomed. Portal may misleadingly show
required; department waives after other items complete. No separately specified mathematics Subject rule
found. [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Conflicting undated official amounts: central program $18,261-21,222 per 9 months; department funding
$18,810-21,861 academic year. Both include eligible resident/nonresident tuition waiver and health insurance;
neither confirms 2027-28 offer. [s3] [s4]
Years of support; Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International TA applicants considered; completed U.S.degree can exempt ITA testing under policy. Otherwise
speaking qualifications/exam may apply. [s4] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Teaching duties vary; inexperienced TAs first receive training rather than direct teaching. Qualifying credit
tuition waiver; confirm nonwaived fees and renewal conditions. [s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Some summer TA support, exceptional-applicant enhancements, advanced faculty-grant RA, university
fellowships typically after study begins and annual academic/teaching awards. [s3] [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International $75 nonrefundable/nontransferable; electronic check or credit/debit card inportal. [s6]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
No international fee waivers except current OSU students/alumni single waiver; UChicago F-1 status does not
qualify. [s6]

sections.title: Conflicts and remaining checks
sections.text:
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Central and departmental stipend ranges differ. English central process explicitly includes in-progress degree
but international page describes earned-degree request. GRE portal may show required despite department
waiver. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s5] [s6]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm current stipend/guarantee, funding application extras, commitment deadline, referee
trigger/receipt/update/reuse and waiver clearance. The expanded faculty shortlist has primary paper evidence;
only older work was located for Asgari and Mantini. Confirm supervision capacity, especially faculty with major
administrative appointments. [s9]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic geometry and representation theory
Edward Richmond
Flag/Schubert varieties, Coxeter groups and algebraic combinatorics. [s9] [s11]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Shifted lower Bruhat intervals are EL-shellable
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Number theory and representation theory
Melissa Emory
Automorphic forms, general Spin groups, multiplicity one and Sato-Tate. Explicitly welcomes prospective
students. [s9] [s10]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 · Nondegeneracy and Sato-Tate distributions of two families of Jacobian varieties
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Arithmetic geometry and dynamics
Paul Fili
Small heights, adelic potential theory, unlikely intersections and equidistribution. [s9] [s12]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2022 · Dynatomic polynomials, necklace operators, and universal relations for dynamical units
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Anand Patel
Moduli of curves and covers, the Hodge bundle, enumerative and projective geometry. [a13] [a13p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2026; accepted in PNAS · The Simplicity of the Hodge Bundle
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic geometry
Jayan Mukherjee
Syzygies and positivity, deformations and smoothings, K3 surfaces, Fano threefolds and moduli of varieties of
general type. [a15] [a15p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2026 · Extendability of general K3 surfaces without gaussian maps and classification of non-prime fano
threefolds
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Arithmetic geometry
Maria Fox
Shimura varieties in positive characteristic, supersingular loci and Deligne-Lusztig geometry. [a17] [a17p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: Online 2025; journal volume 2026 · The Supersingular Locus of the Shimura Variety of GU(2,n-2)
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / arithmetic geometry
John R. Doyle
Arithmetic dynamics; preperiodic points of polynomials over number fields and rational points on dynamical
modular curves. [a19] [a19p]

Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint · Cubic points on dynamical modular curves
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Amit Ghosh
Analytic number theory, quadratic forms and integral points on algebraic surfaces. [a39] [a39p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · On indefinite integral ternary quadratic forms
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / representation theory
Mahdi Asgari
Automorphic representations, Langlands functoriality, local groups and L-functions; trace-formula
combinatorics and toric geometry. [a21] [a21p]
OSU lists Associate Professor; Cornell also retains a Visiting Associate Professor profile. Confirm current physical location and
supervision availability.
Research evidence: Listed in press, 2022, on official Cornell visiting-faculty profile · On combinatorics of the Arthur trace
formula, convex polytopes, and toric varieties
Official profile verifies the title and subject but its publication list is dated; final publication year and newer papers need
confirmation.
Representation theory
Leticia Barchini
Representations of real and p-adic reductive groups, flag-variety orbits, Harish-Chandra modules and
Kazhdan-Lusztig geometry. [a23] [a23p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 · A note on the orbits of a symmetric subgroup in the flag variety
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Lisa Mantini
Lie-group representations, integral transforms and cohomological constructions; current departmental
interests also include finite symmetry and mathematics education. [a43] [a43p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2004; latest relevant paper listed on the official page · Intertwining Ladder Representations for SU(p,q) into
Dolbeault Cohomology
Historical research evidence only. A recent research paper was not located, so current doctoral projects should be checked
explicitly.
Representation theory / number theory
Anthony Kable
Representation theory and invariant theory; recent finite-field work studies cap sets formed by multiplicative
subgroups. [a25] [a25p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Subgroups of Finite Fields As Cap Sets
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Complex geometry
Sean Curry
CR and conformal geometry, several complex variables and geometric analysis, including integrability
questions. [a27] [a27p]
Associate Professor according to the current personal university page; new PhD supervision availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · A smooth counterexample to the Trautman conjecture
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Jiří Lebl
CR geometry, real-analytic and complex varieties, singularities, Levi-flat hypersurfaces and proper holomorphic
maps. [a29] [a29p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 · Intrinsic complexification of real-analytic varieties
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Alan Noell
Several complex variables and CR singularities; approximation, extension and hulls of CR functions. [a31] [a31p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 · CR functions at CR singularities: approximation, extension, and hulls
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Dami Lee
Riemann and translation surfaces, explicit geometric models, monodromy and minimal surfaces; a geometric
rather than arithmetic emphasis. [a41] [a41p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 preprint; author lists accepted in Osaka Journal of Mathematics · Ruled zero mean curvature surfaces
in the three-dimensional light cone
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Number theory / complex analysis
Igor Pritsker
Polynomial heights and Mahler measure, algebraic integers, potential theory and zeros of polynomials. [a33]
[a33p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 · Schinzel-type bounds for the Mahler measure on lemniscates
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Algebraic geometry / commutative algebra
Chris Francisco
Combinatorial commutative algebra, monomial ideals, resolutions and Frobenius powers. [a35] [a35p]
Professor and Senior Vice Provost on the departmental directory; administrative responsibilities make supervision availability
especially important to confirm.
Research evidence: 2025 · Computing generalized Frobenius powers of monomial ideals
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Jeffrey Mermin
Monomial ideals, combinatorial commutative algebra, syzygies and generalized Frobenius powers. [a37] [a37p]
Current departmental faculty; accepting new doctoral students is not confirmed publicly.
Research evidence: 2025 · Computing generalized Frobenius powers of monomial ideals
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

Oklahoma State University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
PhD route includes 90 credits beyond bachelor’s (60 beyond master’s); UChicago bachelor’s an eligible degree
basis. International applicants accepted; substantive math preparedness reviewed by committee. [s3] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare PDF personal statement, CV, complete transcripts and three referee names/emails; fee payment
completes submission. Financial-resource documents may follow review but required for I-20 after admission.
[s1] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Melissa Emory explicitly welcomes prospective PhD email with brief
background/interests:melissa.emory@okstate.edu. No department-wide supervisor-preapproval requirement
found. [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Slate; application status available after submission. Central FAQ says submitted application cannot be edited;
check with admissions for corrections. [s1] [s5] [s7]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing admissions/funding; English policies updated for 2026 scale.2027 financial package not published in
checked sources. [s1] [s6]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Funding consideration [Standing rule]
February 1 fall full-consideration deadline; applications accepted rolling afterward. Standing dates, no explicit
2027-specific funding schedule. [s1] [s3]
Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Full materials by February 1 for full consideration; central says program may decline late/incomplete files.
Self-reported English results accepted initially, official needed for final admission. [s5] [s6] [s7]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL 79(old)/4.0(new from January 21, 2026), IELTS 6.5, DET 115, PTE 53; 2 year validity. Program may set
higher minimum/limit acceptedtests. [s6]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Central application process exempts completed OR completing English-medium bachelor’s/graduate degree in
English-primary country, supporting UChicago in-progress degree. International page instead says request

earned-degree waiver; confirm checklist clearance. Completed qualifying degree is also exempt from ITA
policy. [s5] [s6] [s8]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
GRE not required and omission not counted against applicant; scores welcomed. Portal may misleadingly show
required; department waives after other items complete. No separately specified mathematics Subject rule
found. [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Complete unofficial recent transcripts accepted as PDF. Central requires bachelor’s pending/conferred and any
graduate/professional work; official final records for admission as requested. [s1] [s5]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Math course list with textbooks especially helpful within CV; encouraged, not separately mandatory. [s1]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three, usually former instructors/supervisors; submit names/emails. [s1]
Scholarship references; What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission; Receipt
confirmation [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Reapplication after rejection/declined offer requires new application, fee and all supporting documents.
Specific letter-transfer/update permission not established. [s7]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required current CV in PDF; include math courses/textbooks if possible. No public page cap. [s1]
Statement of purpose; Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Required short PDF personal statement explaining short/long-term goals and how OSU graduate program
supports them (paraphrased). No numerical word/page cap. [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Central SOP guidance includes academic background, research/professional interests and program fit; no
separate research-interest essay specified. [s5]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Scholarship
essays; Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Math course list with textbooks especially helpful within CV; encouraged, not separately mandatory. [s1]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Conflicting undated official amounts: central program $18,261-21,222 per 9 months; department funding
$18,810-21,861 academic year. Both include eligible resident/nonresident tuition waiver and health insurance;
neither confirms 2027-28 offer. [s3] [s4]
Years of support; Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Not established by the cited public admissions materials. Confirm in the current application or with graduate
admissions before relying on a rule.
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International TA applicants considered; completed U.S.degree can exempt ITA testing under policy. Otherwise
speaking qualifications/exam may apply. [s4] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Teaching duties vary; inexperienced TAs first receive training rather than direct teaching. Qualifying credit
tuition waiver; confirm nonwaived fees and renewal conditions. [s4]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Some summer TA support, exceptional-applicant enhancements, advanced faculty-grant RA, university
fellowships typically after study begins and annual academic/teaching awards. [s3] [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International $75 nonrefundable/nontransferable; electronic check or credit/debit card inportal. [s6]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
No international fee waivers except current OSU students/alumni single waiver; UChicago F-1 status does not
qualify. [s6]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Central and departmental stipend ranges differ. English central process explicitly includes in-progress degree
but international page describes earned-degree request. GRE portal may show required despite department
waiver. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s5] [s6]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm current stipend/guarantee, funding application extras, commitment deadline, referee
trigger/receipt/update/reuse and waiver clearance. The expanded faculty shortlist has primary paper evidence;
only older work was located for Asgari and Mantini. Confirm supervision capacity, especially faculty with major
administrative appointments. [s9]
